sources.entry: basedpyright - A pyright fork with stricter defaults and Pylance features in its language server.

summary.one_liner: basedpyright is a fork of Microsoft's pyright Python type checker that adds stricter type checking defaults, extra checks, and some Pylance language server features.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes basedpyright as a fork of pyright, the Python static type checker. It says the fork includes various type checking improvements and Pylance features, and that it provides more than the upstream project. The README itself is brief and points to external documentation for the reasons the fork exists and a full list of features and changes relative to pyright. Specific features are not enumerated in the README text provided. The vinta/awesome-python listing describes it as having stricter defaults and Pylance features in its language server.
use_cases: type-check Python code more strictly than pyright defaults
find type errors before running Python code
get Pylance-style features in a non-VS Code editor
run static type analysis in CI for Python projects
improve type hints coverage in a Python codebase
notable: Fork of pyright with stricter type checking defaults
Includes Pylance-style features in its language server
Full feature list and rationale are kept in external documentation
caveats: README is very short and gives no install or run instructions; details are in external documentation
Feature list is not included in the README text provided
Relies on pyright upstream as its base
